defects.expected: Each page has a main section and a main heading, heading levels do not skip, and table headings have text.
defects.actual: None of the five pages marks its main section, and much of the content sits outside any section. The home page has no main heading, a cart heading skips a level, and the cart's picture column has an empty heading.
defects.expectedBasis: Screen reader users cannot easily jump to the part of the page they want.

evidence.label: TC-70 axe report with full results per page (chromium, 2026-11-10)

defects.nextAction: None; accessibility is not part of this testing, so this is kept for the record only.

defects.title: Keyboard: on Firefox, Tab from the top of the Log in page misses the Email field
defects.environment: https://demowebshop.tricentis.com/login; Playwright Firefox, Chromium and WebKit
steps: Open the Log in page
Press Tab again and again from the top of the page and count the presses until the Email field is selected
defects.expected: Keyboard users can reach the Email field with Tab in every browser.
defects.actual: This is not a site defect. The Email field is already selected when the Log in page opens. The test pressed Tab from there and, on Firefox, left the page, so it wrongly reported that Email was not reached.
defects.expectedBasis: Keyboard users must be able to reach every field.

evidence.label: Re-probe 2026-11-10: focus after load = input#Email (autofocus) on chromium, firefox and webkit

defects.nextAction: Nothing to change on the site.

## 1. Requirement Summary

No user stories or acceptance criteria were supplied, and the user named no flows ("agent decides, by risk"). The scope was proposed in `requirements.md` and confirmed by the user decisions D1 to D5 (`intake.md`, `requirements.md` section 8).

| ASSUMPTION-01 | existingUser has no addresses, orders or reward points | n/a | 1 |

User decisions that shape the suite:

- **D1** Own items only in the account cart and wishlist; the pre-existing "14.1-inch Laptop" is never touched.
- **D2** One shared account for three browsers: run serially; state-changing signed-in tests run on Chromium only.
- **D3** Cash On Delivery orders may be placed (never any card or other payment method).
- **D4** Default priorities from `requirements.md`; accessibility is report-only.
- **D6** (2026-11-10) Accessibility is out of scope for this demo site; TC-68 to TC-70 removed.
- **D5** COD orders are placed **as a guest** with fictional data; signed-in checkout stops at Billing.

## 2. Application URL and Environment

- URL: `https://demowebshop.tricentis.com/` (no redirect chain; all 12 crawled pages returned 200, `discovery.md` section 1).
- Environment: public, shared nopCommerce demo operated by Tricentis, not owned by us. Its data is shared with other users of the site.
- No `data-testid` attributes exist (crawl `testIdCount: 0`).
- The third-party script `s7.addthis.com` fails DNS and stalls the page `load` event. The suite blocks it with an auto fixture and navigates with `domcontentloaded` (architecture K5, R-03).
- Tooling: Playwright 1.64; projects chromium, firefox and webkit; `screenshot: 'on'`, `video: 'retain-on-failure'` (`playwright.config.ts`).
- Credentials: role `existingUser` (email, password) in the git-ignored local file `credentials/credentials.xlsx`; `check` OK on 2026-11-05.
